SDS_Admin_Hub.name: Main Bullpen / Admin Hub
SDS_Admin_Hub.text: Cramped multi-use workplace hub with desks, carts, open panels, printers, vents, monitors, corporate signage and the nearby taped-off break-room microwave. Busy, readable and maintained.

SDS_West_Corridor.name: West Corridor
SDS_West_Corridor.text: Narrow maintained station corridor with access panels, doors at both ends, safety lighting and a small observation window to spectacular space that the coworkers mostly ignore.

SDS_Break_Room.name: Break Room
SDS_Break_Room.text: Ordinary shared employee break room with microwave, vending machine, chairs, printer/forms and accumulated workplace residue. Institutional, familiar and recognizably workplace-scale.
